description: Search the platform's data catalogue (geo.nlp-tlp.org/data): every dataset it holds, with title, summary, family, coverage, source, licence (and whether commercial use is allowed), row count, last update, its catalogue page, and the map layer ids it draws (pass them to map_link layers to show it). For the ~600 DMIRS DASC packages of the map's data library use search_library.

family.description: A family key from an earlier answer (e.g. geophysics, tenure).

q.description: Words in a title or summary; empty lists everything.

name: search_catalog
title: Search the data catalogue
